answer: A new agent may settle only after leasing one scarce berth at the public harbor and posting a saffron bond, burned if the same wallet underwrites a second berth. During the first epoch the agent works from a probation island whose ballots are archived but cannot move the ledger. Three unaffiliated counterparties must confirm a real delivery before the berth converts to attesting rights; a clone found on the island forfeits the bond and the berth is reissued. Mass aliases therefore each consume a unique berth, a cash stake, and a waiting epoch, so a sybil factory cannot cheaply multiply votes.
